task: Create one single playing card as a finished, front-facing card illustration, not a photograph of a card.

style.medium: Hand-drawn cartoon illustration by a professional comic and children's-book illustrator; confident dark-brown ink linework, expressive sketch hatching, soft watercolor washes, and simple colored-pencil shading.
style.character_design: Humorous, charming, slightly exaggerated caricature with large expressive eyes and a mischievous grin; warm and friendly, never crude.
style.palette: Warm natural earth tones, muted pastels, cream, warm gray, taupe, and golden yellow; gentle highlights; no neon colors.
style.background: Mostly clean off-white/cream paper with subtle paper grain. Only a small, light ground vignette beneath the subject, as described in card.themed_vignette. No full-color background fill.
style.card_frame: Portrait 2:3 trading-card layout with rounded corners, thin white outer border, dark-brown rounded inner outline, and softly textured cream paper.
style.number_style: Hand-lettered bold chunky numerals, golden-yellow fill, thick dark-brown outline, and slight hand-drawn shadow, reminiscent of a classic 1990s German family card game.
style.linework: Loose but confident dark-brown/near-black ink outlines, varied hand-drawn strokes, fine hatching and crosshatching for fur and shadows.
style.shading: Soft watercolor texture with colored-pencil accents and small cream highlights; avoid glossy, photorealistic, or 3D rendering.
style.consistency: Use the same frame, paper texture, outline weight, shading technique, and numeral treatment across the card set.

card.subject: A short stack of gold coins next to a small cloth money pouch tied with string.
card.pose: Centered object, shown slightly from the front, entirely visible and uncropped.
card.themed_vignette: A tiny soft shadow and one loose coin beneath the stack.

number.style: Large golden-yellow chunky numerals with thick dark-brown outline and slight hand-drawn drop shadow

card.text_rule: The number 50 is the only text on the card (shown twice). No other words, letters, labels, logos, or symbols that resemble text.
card.frame_accent: Money card of the same set: identical frame, plus one thin golden inner frame line.

composition.subject_scale: large and centered, filling most of the inner card area
composition.number_clearance: Keep the upper-left corner clear enough for the number 50 and the lower-right corner clear for its rotated copy; do not overlap the numerals with the subject.
composition.framing: Show the full card front-on, with no perspective tilt, tabletop, hands, or surrounding scene.
